messages:
alejandra: Heads-up — finalizing the RFC review sync for Thu 10:00am PT. Need to lock authors/order and confirm pre-reads by EOD Wed. Current draft slots:
• 10:00 — Storage API RFC (david)
• 10:25 — Smart routing RFC (sophia)
• 10:50 — Batching/kv-cache RFC (mike)
Can folks swap/cover or request ordering changes? Also need 2 volunteer reviewers for each RFC.

mike: I can present but 10:50 is rough for me (back-to-back). If someone can take batching at 10:50 I can move earlier. @jess any chance you can swap?

sophia: @david would you be OK moving storage later by 10m so we can fit a short demo for routing? I'm +1 to reorder if it helps.

david: Prefer earlier actually — I'm on EMEA call at 11:30 PT, so earlier is better. If we must reorder, can we do: 10:00 routing, 10:25 storage, 10:50 batching?

jess: I can take the 10:50 slot if people want. Happy to review batching.

alejandra: Thanks — new tentative order based on comments: 10:00 routing (sophia), 10:25 storage (david), 10:50 batching (jess). @mike do you still want to present or pair with jess for batching?

mike: I'll pair with @jess — I can do a 10-min deep-dive then hand off to her for Q&A. Reviewers: @matt and @alejandra can you review batching pre-read?

matt: I can review batching pre-read. Quick ask — can we get pre-reads in the channel so reviewers can add inline comments?

review-bot: Pre-reads uploaded: 
• https://redwood.company/docs/rfcs/storage-api-draft
• https://redwood.company/docs/rfcs/smart-routing-v2
• https://redwood.company/docs/rfcs/batching-kv-cache-proposal
(Comments enabled; please tag reviewers with :eyes:)

alejandra: Pre-read checklist (please confirm done by EOD Wed):
```
- Read RFC doc (skim + comments)
- Add at least one substantive comment or question
- Flag any blocking concerns in-thread
- Confirm you can attend the sync or nominate a proxy
```

jess: Confirmed — will add comments on batching by Tue evening. Can also take notes during the meeting.

matt: Will read routing + batching pre-reads and add comments. If anything is blocking I'll ping here.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: Thu 10:00am PT — "RFC Review Sync" — attendees: eng@redwood, sophia, david, jess, mike, matt. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=xyz

sophia: Small agenda tweak — add 5m at the start for quick infra updates (autoscaler metrics). OK?

alejandra: Fine by me — I'll move routing to 10:00, infra update 10:05, then storage 10:10, batching 10:30, 10:50 for overflow/Q&A. Adding time markers in calendar.

david: Thanks. One more ask — can the author slide deck be attached to the RFC doc? saves time.

mike: I'll upload a 3-slide summary for batching before Wed EOD.

alejandra: Perfect. Last call for swaps/coverage — if you need to proxy, say so now. Otherwise assume order locked and pre-reads required. :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup: all good from me.

matt: :eyes: reading now, will comment tonight.

review-bot: Reminder scheduled 12h before meeting to this thread.

alejandra: Thanks everyone — closing the loop. If any blockers appear, ping here or DM.
